**Your agent can now clip pages for you.**

> Find five fintech landing pages with great motion and clip them into fintech-serious.

Artspo 0.8.0 adds a small MCP server (`mcp/artspo_mcp.py`, Python 3, no dependencies) that runs on your computer while your agent does. The extension connects to it on its own, so an agent can queue pages for Artspo to clip, check on them, and read your library. There's no hosted server and no account, and nothing leaves your computer.

Pages open in your own Chrome, logged-in sessions included, so by default an agent only **asks**: approve or decline each request in the popup when the badge shows **?**. Setup → *Let your agent clip pages* can switch that to "Clip without asking", or off.

### Set it up

- **Claude Code:** the plugin now includes the server: `/plugin install artspo --marketplace bryfeng/artspo`.
- **Codex, Cursor and others:** `sh install.sh` copies it to `~/.artspo/mcp/artspo_mcp.py`. [docs/MCP.md](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/MCP.md) has the config for each.
- **Updating from 0.7.x:** `git pull`, click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`, run `sh install.sh`.

### Also

- Links added as a list now record where their clip folders are on disk.
- The skill (and your library's `AGENTS.md`) explains the new tools and when not to use them.

### Files

- `artspo-0.8.0.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.8.0.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
